requirement: server-side object ownership/permission check exists on every read/write route
architecture_reasoning: Reviewed app/dashboard/views.py, the only view module in this deployment: it serves a single shared, read-only aggregate dashboard computed from org-wide totals with no per-object URL parameter, no user-owned record lookup, and no object identifier accepted anywhere in the request path. The applicability signal for SEC-001 ('app exposes per-object resources addressable by an id that a user could access cross-account') is absent: there is no per-object resource for an ownership check to apply to.
call_chain: HTTP request -> auth middleware (session) -> OrdersView.get/post -> Order.objects.get(pk=order_id) -> ownership check -> response

evidence_references.detail: single route registered, org-wide aggregate query with no id parameter and no per-user record lookup

result_reasoning: SEC-001 does not apply to this deployment: no route accepts an object id or loads a user-owned record, so there is no object-level access boundary to enforce or violate.
